description: This file defines a custom Code Block node for a rich text editor built with Tiptap and ProseMirror. It includes node creation, parsing, rendering, commands, keyboard shortcuts, input rules, plugins, and node view logic for handling code blocks with syntax highlighting, indentation, and paste handling.

classes.name: CodeBlock
classes.description: A custom Tiptap Node extension for code blocks with syntax highlighting, indentation, and paste handling.

methods.name: exitOnTripleEnter
methods.description: Handles exiting a code block on triple Enter key press.

methods.name: indentOnEnter
methods.description: Handles indentation when pressing Enter inside a code block.

methods.name: getNewline
methods.description: Calculates the newline and indentation string based on current line.

methods.name: getSelectedLines
methods.description: Retrieves lines within the code block that are selected.

methods.name: parseIndentation
methods.description: Parses indentation attributes from a code block node.

methods.name: getLineAt
methods.description: Finds the line at a specific position.

methods.name: inRange
methods.description: Checks if a number is within a range.

methods.name: indent
methods.description: Creates indentation string based on type and amount.

methods.name: compareCaretPosition
methods.description: Compares previous and next caret positions.

methods.name: fixIndentation
methods.description: Fixes indentation of code using detect-indent and redent.

methods.name: detectCodeBlock
methods.description: Detects if pasted content is a code block and infers language.

methods.name: inferLanguage
methods.description: Infers programming language from class name or attribute.

methods.name: createCodeblockId
methods.description: Generates a unique ID for code blocks.
